card.name: Digits in toll-free phone numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit 5 inside a 1-800-5xx phone number, such as the Fresenius Kabi contact line. It also fires weakly on the opening bracket after 'Patient Counseling Information' in cross-references.

modes.label: Phone number digit
modes.description: The digit 5 at the start of the last seven digits of a 1-800 number in adverse-event reporting lines.
modes.example: Report any diagnosis of NSF following gadobutrol administration to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC at 1-800-5<<5>>1-7176 or FDA

modes.label: Cross-reference bracket
modes.description: The opening parenthesis right after 'Patient Counseling Information' before the section number 17.

modes.label: Other scattered spots
modes.description: Occasional hits on 'pharmacist' after 'healthcare provider or' and on a period inside section numbers.
